observations: body L1-L4: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXIII) add to p. 181, ll. 1-4 that the theorem of the proportionality of the sines of the angles to the opposite sides in a plane triangle is already mentioned by al-Bīrūnī, as a thing known to all (Chronology, p. 184 of the text, p. 166 of the translation).
body L3: a speck stands before «mense»; it is not a sign.
body L7, L9, L13, L15, L21: the root signs are printed as a V with the bar over the radicand; set as root signs.

body L7-L23: the formulas are checked. In the figure of p. 180, AC² = CB² + AB² gives (β), and sin h = R AB/AC gives (γ). In the figure of this page, with BA = p and BC the umbra erecta, BC = p tg h gives (δ), cos h = R BA/AC gives (ε) and sin h = R BC/AC gives (ζ). For the radius R, cosec h = R²/sin h, sec h = R²/cos h, cotg h = R cos h/sin h and tg h = R sin h/cos h; with these (α′)-(ζ′) are identities, (β′) from cosec² h = R² + cotg² h.

body L12-L17: the figure stands at the right of lines 12 to 17; the last of them is set in a narrower measure, and the C of the figure stands after «partium». The figure is redrawn from measurements of the print: the gnomon BA and the umbra erecta BC as solid lines, the ray AC in dashes, each dash where it printed; the angle h at A (about 59° as drawn) and the angle 90° − h at C; the letters and words in the italic of the text: «gnomon» over BA, «umbra crecta» set upward beside BC, «90°−h» set along the ray.

body L12-L17: the label beside BC is printed «umbra crecta», with c for the first e of erecta (as «umbra cxtensa» on p. 180); in «90°−h» the minus sign printed as a short stroke joined to the degree sign. Kept as printed.
body L19: the hyphen of «po-» printed only as a dot.
body L26: the gnomon is written ν in the formula of Delambre, and N is his zenith distance (12 tang N = 12 cot h); kept as printed.
body L28: «10/2» is printed as a small fraction, ¹⁰/₂ (= 5 = 60/12).

notes_left L5-L6: the dash of «aṭ-Ṭūsī» measures 3.6 pt, that of «al-Battānī» 3.4 pt, as the hyphens of the notes (2.6-3.1 pt); the dash of «ad–dīn» is longer, about 4.8 pt. Transcribed as hyphens and a long dash.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
